      "status_by_quote": "I'd keep the txid of a segwit tx out of the reconsiderable filter: a low-feerate copy with a mutated witness also fails as `TX_RECONSIDERABLE`"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6112305457",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Catalog all known cases, put them under test, and address them as a group rather than fixing piecemeal.",
